changes.text: Home has two modes: Top-down (sector and industry rotation map, best value stock in each rising industry) and Bottom-up
Bottom-up short term: trend turning up plus analyst consensus 20%+ above price, with broker count and freshness
Long-term sections: Undiscovered value, Beaten-up value, GARP, Multibagger potential, Hidden value
Stock Summary tab: scorecard, hidden-value metrics, analyst consensus (only when it exists), Bull/Base/Bear for scanned stocks
Every financial number is computed from company filings on NSE; tap any value to see its formula, inputs and the filing. A dash means it could not be computed
Feedback and deep-scan requests are sent from inside the app
No market-cap upper limit; trade bands no longer show a computed target
Undervalued lens ranks by overall score and skips P/E below 5 (one-offs and distressed stocks)
Timeline dates show as month and year (e.g. May '26)
Results checkpoints show the announced board-meeting source instead of the SEBI deadline
Update popup lists only changes since your installed version
First release: Home lenses, Discover, stock page with entry and exit bands
Promises vs actuals timeline with verified source quotes
Upcoming checkpoints, memory of dropped stocks, excluded lookup
Feedback button on every screen and in-app update check
